post.description: Makes an access token for a principal. The answer holds the token itself, and no other call ever shows it again; the server keeps only a hash of its secret. The token expires, in 90 days unless a lifetime of 1 hour to 365 days is asked, and carries the roles asked or all of the owner's. The Idempotency-Key is needed; the key of this call cannot be used again, because the answer holds a secret that is shown once. For administrators only.

get.description: Shows one access token and its state; never the secret or the hash. The id current stands for the token of this request, and then the answer also says who is calling (subject), which is the way to check a token. Any other id is answered to its owner and to an administrator; for anyone else it is not found.

parameters.description: The id of the token (not the token itself), or the word current.
